test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CACTUS' is written as 'ACTCSU' and 'DESERT' is written as 'EDESTR'. How will 'SAFARI' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘CACTUS is written as ACTCSU’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8429b18195305b4815ce816e8597348c979c86aa96892399e2fb8a34288f320.png] 

For, 'DESERT is written as EDESTR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d46493f576f49dd6b8e01947afba9473f9340e28ebb22e8c1921d7bbad6a053a.png] 

Similarly, for '**SAFARI**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9bb663fbe6bfd026ed9cc1dff870ae529fec17f6d35a31f9110a27ec1912cdc.png] 

So, 'SAFARI' will be written as 'ASAFIR'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
